I have a clear picture of the test landscape. Now let me write the RCA and design the fix.

## The fix plan

### `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`
1. Add `warnings` field to `ProviderModelBinding` (List<String>, identity-excluded, documented: loud non-fatal resolution notes; hosts render).
2. `_validateModelEndpoint` returns `List<String>` warnings instead of void:
   - prefix branch: if `headSpec.api != spec.api`:
     - endpoint known (matches any catalog default endpoint via sameEndpoint) → fatal (unchanged).
     - endpoint unknown → warning appended, no throw (gh-1624 fix).
   - family branch unchanged (already scoped to family-exclusive canonical endpoints) — returns no warnings.
3. `resolve` collects warnings and passes into constructor. `if (!override)` branch: `warnings.addAll(_validateModelEndpoint(...))` + keep `_validateWireEndpoint` (void, unchanged — it already passes unknown endpoints).
4. Add a helper `_knownCatalogEndpoint(String baseUrl)` — true when any catalog record's defaultBaseUrl matches via sameEndpoint. Note `_validateWireEndpoint` iterates the same way; I can factor a tiny helper or just inline the loop.

Wait — subtle point: `_validateWireEndpoint` throws when the endpoint matches a catalog record of a DIFFERENT dialect. On the bifrost path `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic` — unknown → passes. Good.

But consider the prefix-branch known-endpoint case: e.g., binding kind `openai` on api.anthropic.com with model `zai/glm-5.3`. `_validateWireEndpoint` fires FIRST (api.anthropic.com speaks anthropic-messages, binding openai-completions → fatal wire mismatch). So the prefix fatal on known endpoints is mostly reachable when the binding's dialect AGREES with the endpoint's record dialect but the model prefix disagrees... e.g. binding openai-completions on api.openai.com with model `zai/glm-5.3`: wire check passes (openai endpoint speaks openai-completions == spec.api), prefix check: zai speaks openai-completions == spec.api → no throw. Hmm. When IS the prefix branch fatal on a known endpoint? headSpec.api != spec.api AND the endpoint is known AND wire check passed. Wire check passes when endpoint's record api == spec.api. Prefix fatal when headSpec.api != spec.api == endpoint api. E.g.: custom record? No — catalog. Binding `anthropic` record... wait spec must resolve: e.g. providerKind 'anthropic', baseUrl = api.anthropic.com (anthropic record's own endpoint), model 'openai/gpt-4o': wire check: endpoint api.anthropic.com speaks anthropic-messages == spec.api → pass. prefix: openai speaks openai-completions != anthropic-messages → FATAL on known endpoint. Good — that's exactly the gh-1570 value preserved (AC2-style). 

Now the REG matrix: AC1 (unknown endpoint + prefix mismatch → warning + boots) vs AC2 (known endpoint → fatal). Also keep the family-exclusive fatal for `gpt-5` on api.anthropic.com.

### Existing tests to update (the old contract)

In `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart`:
1. `'the incident configuration is rejected naming both sides'` — anthropic + `zai/glm-5.3-flashx` + `http://192.168.1.10:8080/v1` (UNKNOWN endpoint) → this was the OLD behavior. Per the ticket this exact class is the FALSE POSITIVE (bench incident 1148402110 was actually an OpenAI-compatible proxy — with the new rule it warns, doesn't die). Update: expect resolve() to succeed + warning present. Actually wait — the comment says "anthropic wire spoken to an OpenAI endpoint" — that IS a genuine misconfiguration... but on an unknown endpoint we can't know the endpoint's dialect — the prefix heuristic was the only signal, and it false-positives on translating proxies. The ticket explicitly AC1s this: boots with a warning. So update the test to the warning contract.

2. `'a vendor-prefixed id of another dialect on a non-openai wire is rejected (openai/claude on anthropic binding)'` — unknown endpoint `http://192.168.1.10:8080` → becomes warning case. Update.

Add new tests for the known-endpoint fatal preserving gh-1570: anthropic record + api.anthropic.com + `openai/gpt-4o` → throws.

### AC3 tests
- `wire:` override (declaredWire != spec.kind) skips checks: existing E6 test covers; add one where WITHOUT the override it would now warn (or throw on known endpoint): e.g. anthropic + wire openai-completions + api.anthropic.com... hmm wait — with override, checks skipped → resolves with providerKind openai-completions even on api.anthropic.com. Pin that.
- Equal-kind caveat: anthropic + wire: anthropic → checks still run: on known endpoint api.anthropic.com + model openai/gpt-4o → throws despite wire: anthropic being declared. Document in test comment. Also pin that `wireOverride` is false when declaredWire == spec.kind.

### Host surfacing (warnings)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: after `note: binding — ...` add warning lines for preconfig binding warnings.
- What about `startup.dart`'s two resolve calls? They validate-only (degraded-pair check + partial override gate) — no binding retained for reporting; nothing to surface there (they only throw or pass).
- `providers_queue_runtime.dart`: queue entries resolve bindings; warnings could be collected into the resolution's warnings — let me check if ProviderQueueResolution has a warnings surface... `collectProviderQueueChain` has `skipped_`. There's `ParsedProviderQueue.warnings` at parse time. The runtime builds ChainEntry list. To keep the fix minimal, I could thread binding warnings into a `warnings` out-param if it exists. Let me check `ProviderQueueResolution`/`collectProviderQueueChain` signature. Actually — minimal: the ticket's factory path is FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG (preconfig). The queue path also exit-64s on the same check... but with the fix the queue just stops throwing (warnings silently dropped there is acceptable? "Private/proxy endpoints get a warning, never exit 64" — a dropped warning in the queue path is less than ideal but the primary AC surface is the boot/UT/IT).

Let me check what surfaces exist for queue warnings. Look at providers_queue_runtime.dart resolution class quickly.

Actually, let me look at how `collectProviderQueueChain` is called and whether there's a warnings channel.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.

I have a clear picture of the test landscape. Now let me write the RCA and design the fix.

## The fix plan

### `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`
1. Add `warnings` field to `ProviderModelBinding` (List<String>, identity-excluded, documented: loud non-fatal resolution notes; hosts render).
2. `_validateModelEndpoint` returns `List<String>` warnings instead of void:
   - prefix branch: if `headSpec.api != spec.api`:
     - endpoint known (matches any catalog default endpoint via sameEndpoint) → fatal (unchanged).
     - endpoint unknown → warning appended, no throw (gh-1624 fix).
   - family branch unchanged (already scoped to family-exclusive canonical endpoints) — returns no warnings.
3. `resolve` collects warnings and passes into constructor. `if (!override)` branch: `warnings.addAll(_validateModelEndpoint(...))` + keep `_validateWireEndpoint` (void, unchanged — it already passes unknown endpoints).
4. Add a helper `_knownCatalogEndpoint(String baseUrl)` — true when any catalog record's defaultBaseUrl matches via sameEndpoint. Note `_validateWireEndpoint` iterates the same way; I can factor a tiny helper or just inline the loop.

Wait — subtle point: `_validateWireEndpoint` throws when the endpoint matches a catalog record of a DIFFERENT dialect. On the bifrost path `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic` — unknown → passes. Good.

But consider the prefix-branch known-endpoint case: e.g., binding kind `openai` on api.anthropic.com with model `zai/glm-5.3`. `_validateWireEndpoint` fires FIRST (api.anthropic.com speaks anthropic-messages, binding openai-completions → fatal wire mismatch). So the prefix fatal on known endpoints is mostly reachable when the binding's dialect AGREES with the endpoint's record dialect but the model prefix disagrees... e.g. binding openai-completions on api.openai.com with model `zai/glm-5.3`: wire check passes (openai endpoint speaks openai-completions == spec.api), prefix check: zai speaks openai-completions == spec.api → no throw. {"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.

+  // KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring _validateWireEndpoint's "unknown
+  // endpoints pass" rule). Translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api)
+  // serve multiple dialect paths and route "vendor/model" prefixes as
+  // keys — a prefix mismatch on such an endpoint is a WARNING, never the
+  // exit 64 the 1.0.576 preflight produced. This group runs on every PR
+  // touching provider_model_binding.dart.
+  group('ProviderModelBinding.resolve — vendor-prefix endpoint scoping '
+      '(gh-1624 REG, AC1/AC2/AC3)', () {
+    test('AC1: vendor-prefixed model of another dialect on an UNKNOWN '
+        'endpoint boots with a warning (was exit 64)', () {
+      // The exact factory binding from gh-1624: zai/glm-5.3 through
+      // bifrost's anthropic path — the prefix is a routing key there.
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.providerKind, 'anthropic');
+      expect(binding.baseUrl, 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic');
+      expect(binding.warnings, hasLength(1));
+      expect(
+        binding.warnings.single,
+        allOf(
+          contains('zai/glm-5.3'),
+          contains('"zai"'),
+          contains('openai-completions'),
+          contains('"anthropic-messages"'),
+          contains('http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic'),
+          contains('routing key'),
+        ),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC2: the same mismatch on a KNOWN vendor endpoint is still '
+        'fatal (gh-1570 fail-fast preserved)', () {
+      // openai-prefixed id on the anthropic record's own endpoint: the
+      // catalog verdict stands, the boot dies naming both sides.
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(
+              contains('openai/gpt-4o'),
+              contains('"openai"'),
+              contains('api.anthropic.com'),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(isA<ConfigException>()),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC2: an anthropic-wire binding on a known OPENAI endpoint with '
+        'a claude id stays rejected (family-exclusive verdict intact)',
+        () {
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.openai.com/v1',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(contains('api.openai.com'), contains('anthropic')),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC3: wire: override (declaredWire != record kind) skips both '
+        'checks — even where they would fire — and yields no warning',
+        () {
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+        wire: 'openai-completions',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.providerKind, 'openai-completions');
+      expect(binding.wireOverride, isTrue);
+      expect(binding.warnings, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('AC3 caveat: wire: EQUAL to the record kind does NOT engage the '
+        'override — the checks still run', () {
+      // The undocumented footgun from gh-1624: record anthropic +
+      // `wire: anthropic` changes nothing — the vendor-prefix verdict on
+      // the known endpoint still fires, and a passing binding carries no
+      // override marker.
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+          wire: 'anthropic',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(isA<ConfigException>()),

+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
+        baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+        wire: 'anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.wireOverride, isFalse);
+      expect(binding.warnings, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('warnings are report notes, not identity (I5 round-trip)', () {
+      final plain = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',

+      );
+      expect(plain, equals(same));

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.

{"patch":"[test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart#C25C]

+  // gh-1624 REG matrix: the vendor-prefix dialect verdict is scoped to
+  // KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring _validateWireEndpoint's "unknown
+  // endpoints pass" rule). Translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api)
+  // serve multiple dialect paths and route "vendor/model" prefixes as
+  // keys — a prefix mismatch on such an endpoint is a WARNING, never the
+  // exit 64 the 1.0.576 preflight produced. This group runs on every PR
+  // touching provider_model_binding.dart.
+  group('ProviderModelBinding.resolve — vendor-prefix endpoint scoping '
+      '(gh-1624 REG, AC1/AC2/AC3)', () {
+    test('AC1: vendor-prefixed model of another dialect on an UNKNOWN '
+        'endpoint boots with a warning (was exit 64)', () {
+      // The exact factory binding from gh-1624: zai/glm-5.3 through
+      // bifrost's anthropic path — the prefix is a routing key there.
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.providerKind, 'anthropic');
+      expect(binding.baseUrl, 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic');
+      expect(binding.warnings, hasLength(1));
+      expect(
+        binding.warnings.single,
+        allOf(
+          contains('zai/glm-5.3'),
+          contains('"zai"'),
+          contains('openai-completions'),
+          contains('"anthropic-messages"'),
+          contains('http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic'),
+          contains('routing key'),
+        ),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC2: the same mismatch on a KNOWN vendor endpoint is still '
+        'fatal (gh-1570 fail-fast preserved)', () {
+      // openai-prefixed id on the anthropic record's own endpoint: the
+      // catalog verdict stands, the boot dies naming both sides.
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(
+              contains('openai/gpt-4o'),
+              contains('"openai"'),
+              contains('api.anthropic.com'),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(isA<ConfigException>()),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC2: an anthropic-wire binding on a known OPENAI endpoint with '
+        'a claude id stays rejected (family-exclusive verdict intact)',
+        () {
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.openai.com/v1',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(contains('api.openai.com'), contains('anthropic')),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC3: wire: override (declaredWire != record kind) skips both '
+        'checks — even where they would fire — and yields no warning',
+        () {
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+        wire: 'openai-completions',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.providerKind, 'openai-completions');
+      expect(binding.wireOverride, isTrue);
+      expect(binding.warnings, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('AC3 caveat: wire: EQUAL to the record kind does NOT engage the '
+        'override — the checks still run', () {
+      // The undocumented footgun from gh-1624: record anthropic +
+      // `wire: anthropic` changes nothing — the vendor-prefix verdict on
+      // the known endpoint still fires, and a passing binding carries no
+      // override marker.
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+          wire: 'anthropic',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(isA<ConfigException>()),
+      );
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
+        baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+        wire: 'anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.wireOverride, isFalse);
+      expect(binding.warnings, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('warnings are report notes, not identity (I5 round-trip)', () {
+      final plain = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      final same = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.restore,
+      );
+      expect(plain, equals(same));
+      expect(plain.hashCode, same.hashCode);
+    });
+  });

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. {"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.

+  // KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring _validateWireEndpoint's "unknown
+  // endpoints pass" rule). Translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api)
+  // serve multiple dialect paths and route "vendor/model" prefixes as
+  // keys — a prefix mismatch on such an endpoint is a WARNING, never the
+  // exit 64 the 1.0.576 preflight produced. This group runs on every PR
+  // touching provider_model_binding.dart.
+  group('ProviderModelBinding.resolve — vendor-prefix endpoint scoping '
+      '(gh-1624 REG, AC1/AC2/AC3)', () {
+    test('AC1: vendor-prefixed model of another dialect on an UNKNOWN '
+        'endpoint boots with a warning (was exit 64)', () {
+      // The exact factory binding from gh-1624: zai/glm-5.3 through
+      // bifrost's anthropic path — the prefix is a routing key there.
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.providerKind, 'anthropic');
+      expect(binding.baseUrl, 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic');
+      expect(binding.warnings, hasLength(1));
+      expect(
+        binding.warnings.single,
+        allOf(
+          contains('zai/glm-5.3'),
+          contains('"zai"'),
+          contains('openai-completions'),
+          contains('"anthropic-messages"'),
+          contains('http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic'),

+    });
+

+        'fatal (gh-1570 fail-fast preserved)', () {
+      // openai-prefixed id on the anthropic record's own endpoint: the
+      // catalog verdict stands, the boot dies naming both sides.
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(
+              contains('openai/gpt-4o'),
+              contains('"openai"'),
+              contains('api.anthropic.com'),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),

+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',

+        'checks — even where they would fire — and yields no warning',

+        providerKind: 'anthropic',

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.
"}

+  // KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring _validateWireEndpoint's "unknown

+  // serve multiple dialect paths and route "vendor/model" prefixes as

+  // exit 64 the 1.0.576 preflight produced. This group runs on every PR
+  // touching provider_model_binding.dart.
+  group('ProviderModelBinding.resolve — vendor-prefix endpoint scoping '
+      '(gh-1624 REG, AC1/AC2/AC3)', () {
+    test('AC1: vendor-prefixed model of another dialect on an UNKNOWN '
+        'endpoint boots with a warning (was exit 64)', () {
+      // The exact factory binding from gh-1624: zai/glm-5.3 through
+      // bifrost's anthropic path — the prefix is a routing key there.
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',

+      expect(binding.baseUrl, 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic');
+      expect(binding.warnings, hasLength(1));
+      expect(
+        binding.warnings.single,
+        allOf(
+          contains('zai/glm-5.3'),
+          contains('"zai"'),
+          contains('openai-completions'),
+          contains('"anthropic-messages"'),
+          contains('http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic'),

+        ),

+    });
+
+    test('AC2: the same mismatch on a KNOWN vendor endpoint is still '
+        'fatal (gh-1570 fail-fast preserved)', () {
+      // openai-prefixed id on the anthropic record's own endpoint: the
+      // catalog verdict stands, the boot dies naming both sides.
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(
+              contains('openai/gpt-4o'),
+              contains('"openai"'),
+              contains('api.anthropic.com'),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,

+          providerKind: 'anthropic',

+        ),
+        throwsA(

+            'message',
+            allOf(contains('api.openai.com'), contains('anthropic')),

+        ),

+    });
+

+        'checks — even where they would fire — and yields no warning',

+        providerKind: 'anthropic',

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.
"}

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

/// The `FA_PROVIDER_*` env preconfig parser. Env values arrive via an
/// injected reader, so every case wires a map-backed closure; no
/// `dart:io` is involved on either side.
///
/// The declaration is machine-written and self-contained: `baseUrl` and
/// `model` are required, `apiKeyEnvVar` is optional-but-strict (declared →
/// the named var MUST resolve; absent → keyless, no env-name probing),
/// every text input has a `_BASE64` twin, and nothing falls back to the
/// catalog spec values.
void main() {
  String? Function(String) envFrom(Map<String, String> vars) =>
      (name) => vars[name];

  String b64(String value) => base64.encode(utf8.encode(value));

  EnvProviderPreconfig? parse({
    String? providerType,
    String? providerName,
    String? providerConfig,
    String? providerConfigBase64,
    Map<String, String> vars = const {},
    Iterable<String> takenNames = const [],
  }) => parseEnvProviderPreconfig(
    providerType: providerType,
    providerName: providerName,
    providerConfig: providerConfig,
    providerConfigBase64: providerConfigBase64,
    envVarValue: envFrom(vars),
    takenNames: takenNames,

+  // KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring _validateWireEndpoint's "unknown
+  // endpoints pass" rule). Translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api)
+  // serve multiple dialect paths and route "vendor/model" prefixes as

+  // exit 64 the 1.0.576 preflight produced. This group runs on every PR
+  // touching provider_model_binding.dart.
+  group('ProviderModelBinding.resolve — vendor-prefix endpoint scoping '
+      '(gh-1624 REG, AC1/AC2/AC3)', () {
+    test('AC1: vendor-prefixed model of another dialect on an UNKNOWN '
+        'endpoint boots with a warning (was exit 64)', () {
+      // The exact factory binding from gh-1624: zai/glm-5.3 through
+      // bifrost's anthropic path — the prefix is a routing key there.
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.providerKind, 'anthropic');
+      expect(binding.baseUrl, 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic');
+      expect(binding.warnings, hasLength(1));
+      expect(
+        binding.warnings.single,
+        allOf(
+          contains('zai/glm-5.3'),
+          contains('"zai"'),
+          contains('openai-completions'),
+          contains('"anthropic-messages"'),
+          contains('http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic'),
+          contains('routing key'),
+        ),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC2: the same mismatch on a KNOWN vendor endpoint is still '
+        'fatal (gh-1570 fail-fast preserved)', () {
+      // openai-prefixed id on the anthropic record's own endpoint: the
+      // catalog verdict stands, the boot dies naming both sides.
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(
+              contains('openai/gpt-4o'),
+              contains('"openai"'),
+              contains('api.anthropic.com'),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,

+        ),
+        throwsA(

+            'message',
+            allOf(contains('api.openai.com'), contains('anthropic')),

+    });

+        'checks — even where they would fire — and yields no warning',

+        providerKind: 'anthropic',

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1624

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: After fa 1.0.576 (PR #1571, gh-1570 binding preflight), a vendor-prefixed model id (`zai/glm-5.3`) on a translating-proxy endpoint (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api serving an anthropic-dialect path) kills every boot with `ConfigException` → exit 64, although the exact same binding worked on 1.0.522.

**Root cause**: `_validateModelEndpoint` in `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` (vendor-prefix branch): for `vendor/model` ids the prefix is resolved against the provider catalog and **any dialect disagreement with the binding is fatal regardless of the endpoint**. On a translating proxy the `vendor/` prefix is a ROUTING KEY, not a dialect declaration — the check is a false positive there. The sibling `_validateWireEndpoint` already encodes the right rule ("unknown endpoints pass — there is nothing declared to check against"); the prefix branch never got it. The family branch (`_familyExclusiveEndpointDialect`) is already correctly scoped to the three family-exclusive canonical endpoints (anthropic/openai/google defaults).

**Impact**: Proxy-factory deployments (the factory image's bifrost at `http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic`) cannot boot the agent at all — full factory stop. A workaround exists but is undocumented for `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` users and is a footgun: `wire:` only silences the checks when it DIFFERS from the provider record's own kind (`override = declaredWire != null && declaredWire != spec.kind`), so `record anthropic + wire: anthropic` silently does nothing.

**Fix approach**:
1. Scope the vendor-prefix check to KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring `_validateWireEndpoint`): on a known endpoint (e.g. api.anthropic.com) a mismatched prefix stays fatal (gh-1570's fail-fast value preserved); on an unknown/private endpoint the mismatch degrades to a **warning** carried on the binding (`ProviderModelBinding.warnings`), never exit 64.
2. Surface the warning on the boot notice (`bin/fah_runapp.dart` prints `binding.warnings` under the FA_PROVIDER_* binding echo) — the exact factory path.
3. Pin the `wire:` override semantics with tests (AC3): `declaredWire != spec.kind` skips the checks; `declaredWire == spec.kind` does NOT (document the caveat).
4. Document `wire:` + the proxy-factory migration (README FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG section, `docs/agents/providers.md`, `--help` env-preconfig text) and add the breaking-change CHANGELOG entry.

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this ticket (refs #1571/#1570).

## Reproduction

UT (RED first): `ProviderModelBinding.resolve(providerKind: 'anthropic', modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3', baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic')` throws today; must resolve with a warning. Plus the IT: a bifrost-shaped loopback proxy (`/anthropic` path speaking anthropic-messages SSE, translating `zai/glm-5.3`) must boot through `parseEnvProviderPreconfig` and complete a streamed request.
"}

+  // gh-1624 REG matrix: the vendor-prefix dialect verdict is scoped to
+  // KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring _validateWireEndpoint's "unknown
+  // endpoints pass" rule). Translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api)
+  // serve multiple dialect paths and route "vendor/model" prefixes as
+  // keys — a prefix mismatch on such an endpoint is a WARNING, never the
+  // exit 64 the 1.0.576 preflight produced. This group runs on every PR
+  // touching provider_model_binding.dart.
+  group('ProviderModelBinding.resolve — vendor-prefix endpoint scoping '
+      '(gh-1624 REG, AC1/AC2/AC3)', () {
+    test('AC1: vendor-prefixed model of another dialect on an UNKNOWN '
+        'endpoint boots with a warning (was exit 64)', () {
+      // The exact factory binding from gh-1624: zai/glm-5.3 through
+      // bifrost's anthropic path — the prefix is a routing key there.
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.providerKind, 'anthropic');
+      expect(binding.baseUrl, 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic');
+      expect(binding.warnings, hasLength(1));
+      expect(
+        binding.warnings.single,
+        allOf(
+          contains('zai/glm-5.3'),
+          contains('"zai"'),
+          contains('openai-completions'),
+          contains('"anthropic-messages"'),
+          contains('http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic'),
+          contains('routing key'),
+        ),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC2: the same mismatch on a KNOWN vendor endpoint is still '
+        'fatal (gh-1570 fail-fast preserved)', () {
+      // openai-prefixed id on the anthropic record's own endpoint: the
+      // catalog verdict stands, the boot dies naming both sides.
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(
+              contains('openai/gpt-4o'),
+              contains('"openai"'),
+              contains('api.anthropic.com'),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,

+      );
+    });
+

+          modelId: 'claude-sonnet-4-5',

+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(contains('api.openai.com'), contains('anthropic')),

+        ),
+      );
+    });
+

+        'checks — even where they would fire — and yields no warning',

+  // exit 64 the 1.0.576 preflight produced. This group runs on every PR
+  // touching provider_model_binding.dart.
+  group('ProviderModelBinding.resolve — vendor-prefix endpoint scoping '
+      '(gh-1624 REG, AC1/AC2/AC3)', () {
+    test('AC1: vendor-prefixed model of another dialect on an UNKNOWN '
+        'endpoint boots with a warning (was exit 64)', () {

+      // bifrost's anthropic path — the prefix is a routing key there.
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',

+      expect(binding.baseUrl, 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic');

+        allOf(
+          contains('zai/glm-5.3'),
+          contains('"zai"'),
+          contains('openai-completions'),
+          contains('"anthropic-messages"'),
+          contains('http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic'),

+

+        'fatal (gh-1570 fail-fast preserved)', () {

+      // catalog verdict stands, the boot dies naming both sides.

+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,

+          isA<ConfigException>().having(

`wire` is optional and declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks
(`openai-completions`, `anthropic`, `google`, …), overriding the provider
record's own kind. **Translating proxies** (bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api:
one host serving several dialect paths, `vendor/model` prefixes used as
routing keys) need nothing extra since gh-1624 — a `vendor/`-prefixed
model whose prefix names another dialect boots with a warning on
unknown/private endpoints instead of refusing to start. Only real vendor
endpoints (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) still fail fast on a
dialect mismatch. The `wire:` override engages ONLY when it differs from
the provider record's own kind (`record anthropic + wire: anthropic`
changes nothing — the checks still run).

# bifrost's anthropic path translating zai/glm-5.3 (no wire: needed):
FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic

arguments.newText:
# Providers

See [cli.md](cli.md) for the `/settings` hub and CLI flags.

## Translating proxies and the `wire:` override (gh-1624)

The boot-time binding preflight validates model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint
(`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`). The vendor-prefix verdict
(`zai/glm-5.3` naming the `zai` record) and the family verdict
(`claude-*`/`gpt-*`/`gemini-*` ids) fire ONLY on known catalog endpoints
(api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is where a dialect
mismatch fails the boot. On unknown/private endpoints the `vendor/`
prefix is treated as a routing key, not a dialect declaration: a
mismatch boots with a `warning: binding — …` line instead of exit 64.
Translating proxies (bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api — one host serving
several dialect paths such as `/anthropic` and `/v1`) need no extra
configuration since gh-1624.

`wire:` (the `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` key, the custom-provider and role
surfaces) declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks, overriding the
provider record's own kind. Caveat: the override engages ONLY when the
declared wire DIFFERS from the record's own kind — `record anthropic +
wire: anthropic` changes nothing and the checks still run. The override
silences the dialect checks entirely (the caller asserts the endpoint
speaks it) and is echoed in every binding report (`wire override:`) so
a silenced check is never invisible.

## Provider catalog (CLI auth flows)

{"newText":"# Providers

See [cli.md](cli.md) for the `/settings` hub and CLI flags.

## Translating proxies and the `wire:` override (gh-1624)

The boot-time binding preflight validates model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint
(`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`). The vendor-prefix verdict
(`zai/glm-5.3` naming the `zai` record) and the family verdict
(`claude-*`/`gpt-*`/`gemini-*` ids) fire ONLY on known catalog endpoints
(api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is where a dialect
mismatch fails the boot. On unknown/private endpoints the `vendor/`
prefix is treated as a routing key, not a dialect declaration: a
mismatch boots with a `warning: binding — …` line instead of exit 64.
Translating proxies (bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api — one host serving
several dialect paths such as `/anthropic` and `/v1`) need no extra
configuration since gh-1624.

`wire:` (the `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` key, the custom-provider and role
surfaces) declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks, overriding the
provider record's own kind. Caveat: the override engages ONLY when the
declared wire DIFFERS from the record's own kind — `record anthropic +
wire: anthropic` changes nothing and the checks still run. The override
silences the dialect checks entirely (the caller asserts the endpoint
speaks it) and is echoed in every binding report (`wire override:`) so
a silenced check is never invisible.

{"newText":"# Providers

See [cli.md](cli.md) for the `/settings` hub and CLI flags.

## Translating proxies and the `wire:` override (gh-1624)

The boot-time binding preflight validates model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint
(`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`). The vendor-prefix verdict
(`zai/glm-5.3` naming the `zai` record) and the family verdict
(`claude-*`/`gpt-*`/`gemini-*` ids) fire ONLY on known catalog endpoints
(api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is where a dialect
mismatch fails the boot. On unknown/private endpoints the `vendor/`
prefix is treated as a routing key, not a dialect declaration: a
mismatch boots with a `warning: binding — …` line instead of exit 64.
Translating proxies (bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api — one host serving
several dialect paths such as `/anthropic` and `/v1`) need no extra
configuration since gh-1624.

`wire:` (the `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` key, the custom-provider and role
surfaces) declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks, overriding the
provider record's own kind. Caveat: the override engages ONLY when the
declared wire DIFFERS from the record's own kind — `record anthropic +
wire: anthropic` changes nothing and the checks still run. The override
silences the dialect checks entirely (the caller asserts the endpoint
speaks it) and is echoed in every binding report (`wire override:`) so
a silenced check is never invisible.

arguments.newText:
`wire:` (the `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` key; `ProviderModelBinding.resolve`
takes it as `wire:`) declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks,
overriding the provider record's own kind. Caveat: the override engages
ONLY when the declared wire DIFFERS from the record's own kind —
`record anthropic + wire: anthropic` changes nothing and the checks
still run. The override silences the dialect checks entirely (the caller
asserts the endpoint speaks it) and is echoed in every binding report
(`wire override:`) so a silenced check is never invisible.

{"patch":"[test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart#C25C]
INS.POST 236:
+  // gh-1624 REG matrix: the vendor-prefix dialect verdict is scoped to
+  // KNOWN catalog endpoints (mirroring _validateWireEndpoint's "unknown
+  // endpoints pass" rule). Translating proxies (bifrost/LiteLLM/one-api)
+  // serve multiple dialect paths and route "vendor/model" prefixes as
+  // keys — a prefix mismatch on such an endpoint is a WARNING, never the
+  // exit 64 the 1.0.576 preflight produced. This group runs on every PR
+  // touching provider_model_binding.dart.
+  group('ProviderModelBinding.resolve — vendor-prefix endpoint scoping '
+      '(gh-1624 REG, AC1/AC2/AC3)', () {
+    test('AC1: vendor-prefixed model of another dialect on an UNKNOWN '
+        'endpoint boots with a warning (was exit 64)', () {
+      // The exact factory binding from gh-1624: zai/glm-5.3 through
+      // bifrost's anthropic path — the prefix is a routing key there.
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.providerKind, 'anthropic');
+      expect(binding.baseUrl, 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic');
+      expect(binding.warnings, hasLength(1));
+      expect(
+        binding.warnings.single,
+        allOf(
+          contains('zai/glm-5.3'),
+          contains('"zai"'),
+          contains('openai-completions'),
+          contains('"anthropic-messages"'),
+          contains('http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic'),
+          contains('routing key'),
+        ),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC2: the same mismatch on a KNOWN vendor endpoint is still '
+        'fatal (gh-1570 fail-fast preserved)', () {
+      // openai-prefixed id on the anthropic record's own endpoint: the
+      // catalog verdict stands, the boot dies naming both sides.
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(
+              contains('openai/gpt-4o'),
+              contains('"openai"'),
+              contains('api.anthropic.com'),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(isA<ConfigException>()),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC2: an anthropic-wire binding on a known OPENAI endpoint with '
+        'a claude id stays rejected (family-exclusive verdict intact)',
+        () {
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.openai.com/v1',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(
+          isA<ConfigException>().having(
+            (e) => e.message,
+            'message',
+            allOf(contains('api.openai.com'), contains('anthropic')),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('AC3: wire: override (declaredWire != record kind) skips both '
+        'checks — even where they would fire — and yields no warning',
+        () {
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+        wire: 'openai-completions',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.providerKind, 'openai-completions');
+      expect(binding.wireOverride, isTrue);
+      expect(binding.warnings, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('AC3 caveat: wire: EQUAL to the record kind does NOT engage the '
+        'override — the checks still run', () {
+      // The undocumented footgun from gh-1624: record anthropic +
+      // `wire: anthropic` changes nothing — the vendor-prefix verdict on
+      // the known endpoint still fires, and a passing binding carries no
+      // override marker.
+      expect(
+        () => ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+          providerKind: 'anthropic',
+          modelId: 'openai/gpt-4o',
+          baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+          wire: 'anthropic',
+          provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+        ),
+        throwsA(isA<ConfigException>()),
+      );
+      final binding = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'claude-sonnet-4-5',
+        baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
+        wire: 'anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      expect(binding.wireOverride, isFalse);
+      expect(binding.warnings, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('warnings are report notes, not identity (I5 round-trip)', () {
+      final plain = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.env,
+      );
+      final same = ProviderModelBinding.resolve(
+        providerKind: 'anthropic',
+        modelId: 'zai/glm-5.3',
+        baseUrl: 'http://192.168.1.23:8080/anthropic',
+        provenance: BindingProvenance.restore,
+      );
+      expect(plain, equals(same));
+      expect(plain.hashCode, same.hashCode);
+    });
+  });

83:final class ProviderModelBinding {

108:  /// wires NEED it or an explicit [baseUrl]). [baseUrl] overrides the
109:  /// record's default endpoint; it is normalized (one trailing slash
110:  /// stripped). [wire] is the explicit `wire:` escape hatch: the declared
111:  /// adapter kind REPLACES the record's own wire kind and silences the
112:  /// dialect checks (the caller asserted the endpoint speaks it); the

{"newText":"# Providers

See [cli.md](cli.md) for the `/settings` hub and CLI flags.

## Translating proxies and the `wire:` override (gh-1624)

The boot-time binding preflight validates model ⇄ dialect ⇄ endpoint
(`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`). The vendor-prefix verdict
(`zai/glm-5.3` naming the `zai` record) and the family verdict
(`claude-*`/`gpt-*`/`gemini-*` ids) fire ONLY on known catalog endpoints
(api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, …) — that is where a dialect
mismatch fails the boot. On unknown/private endpoints the `vendor/`
prefix is treated as a routing key, not a dialect declaration: a
mismatch boots with a `warning: binding — …` line instead of exit 64.
Translating proxies (bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api — one host serving
several dialect paths such as `/anthropic` and `/v1`) need no extra
configuration since gh-1624.

`wire:` (the `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` key, the custom-provider and role
surfaces) declares the adapter kind the endpoint speaks, overriding the
provider record's own kind. Caveat: the override engages ONLY when the
declared wire DIFFERS from the record's own kind — `record anthropic +
wire: anthropic` changes nothing and the checks still run. The override
silences the dialect checks entirely (the caller asserts the endpoint
speaks it) and is echoed in every binding report (`wire override:`) so
a silenced check is never invisible.
